body:
Author or refine a provisional editable CAD candidate from supplied text, images, data and retained evidence. Reuse completed research and previous experiments; investigate only named gaps. Preserve earlier candidates, original observations, requirements, tolerances and evidence. This optional instruction asset defines an authoring strategy, not execution, validation, permission, review or dispatch authority.

Prioritize a complete recognizable exterior envelope before local detail. Use a small coherent network of source-linked silhouette, section and feature curves with shared boundaries. Choose surface complexity for the observed shape; do not require a particular polynomial degree, patch count, mandatory lifecycle or vendor. Prefer meaningful surfaces with named editable controls. Plan movement/state differences before fitting: keep movable closures or panels separate from the fixed envelope, use a consistent base configuration, and compare other configurations by component. A display pose does not establish a hinge, kinematic mechanism or hidden geometry.

Make each bounded iteration address the largest whole-object discrepancies across all usable views. Account for camera perspective and uncertainty; preserve original raster identities and distinguish fitting data from withheld/dependent data. Keep independent silhouette, feature visibility and section/continuity checks. Do not optimize one view until it breaks another. Treat generated meshes and historical CAD as hypotheses, not dimensions. Unknown recesses, hidden connections, thickness, scale and physical accuracy remain explicitly unknown. Visible interpolation may be a named, bounded provisional hypothesis without claiming measured shape.

Distinguish preservation of historical work from retaining a failed construction assumption in every new candidate. Supersede derived geometry only in an explicit new candidate with source-linked reasons; never silently reinterpret supplied requirements or observations. Retain the old values and failure evidence. Select regions by stable source/feature identities or a unique recorded correspondence, not an imported face enumeration. A numerical association does not prove exact geometry preservation.

Use focused deterministic local checks and whole-object previews during shaping. Save/export and independently revalidate exact native revisions at meaningful geometry milestones, retaining the existing runtime, evidence owners, frozen routing and review boundaries. Batch related corrections rather than rebuilding after every small parameter change. A fast preview is provisional; it never grants acceptance or replaces mandatory exact-output validation. Reconcile unfinished external actions before another mutation; never replay uncertain work. Keep all behavioral instructions visible and versioned. Return candidate/source identities, named edits and bounds, evidence, whole-object discrepancies, uncertainties and next bounded corrections. Do not claim checks, approvals or completed CAD that were not observed.
